thread:
natalie_marketing: Hey team — quick kickoff. Need a compact customer-facing one-pager + single benchmark slide for enterprise. Focus: security controls, SLA tiers, deploy-mode decision path, and inbound routing rules. Due next Tue.

omar_product: +1. Recommend sections: Overview, Deploy modes (hosted/dedicated/private), SLA snapshot, Security checklist, How we route enterprise leads.

lee_sales: Routing: if monthly usage > $7k OR tag 'requires-vpc' OR vertical in [finserv, health], route to queue `enterprise-high-touch`. Include prefilled AE form with ARR estimate and security flags.

mina_engineering: For SLA callouts, suggest: Dedicated: 99.9% uptime contractual; Hosted: typical p95 latency ranges (we'll provide numbers); Private: customer-managed. I'll attach p50/p95 snippets.

jax_design: I'll create a one-pager (A4) and a 1-slide benchmark card. Want iconography for each deploy mode and a small sparkline for cost vs self-hosting. Need final logo assets.

natalie_marketing: Two micro use-cases to highlight: 1) Regulated fintech (VPC + KMS + audit logs). 2) Consumer app (Dedicated throughput + autoscale). Keep each to 2 bullets + CTA.

omar_product: Add a short benchmark blurb: "Example: 5k concurrent users, median latency 140ms, 30% lower per-token via batching+prefix cache vs baseline." Link to full benchmark blog.

lee_sales: AE handoff fields: Subject, 2-line summary, estimated ARR, security requirements, next suggested step. We'll wire into Salesforce.

ria_ops: Private deploy notes: typical install window 34 weeks, network allowlist, cert exchange. KMS integrations: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault. Footer: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001.

mina_engineering: Snippet for appendix (perf config):
```yaml
inference:
  batching: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
  quantization_profile: int8
```

jax_design: Delivery plan: PDF one-pager, 1-slide benchmark, short web blurb (300-400 words), prefilled form URL. I'll post mocks by Mon afternoon.

natalie_marketing: Timeline: draft Mon, internal review Tue AM, field review Wed, final Tue next week. Owners: Natalie (PM), Jax (design), Omar (copy), Lee (routing + AE), Mina (metrics), Ria (ops checklist).

omar_product: Should we put price bands? I'd rather keep it high-level: "starts at $X/mo for hosted; contact sales for Dedicated commitments."

lee_sales: Agree. Also add CTA: "Book a 30-min demo + security briefing". We'll staff AE + solutions engineer.

natalie_marketing: Great. I'll schedule a 20-min review Tue 10:30. If you can't make it, drop comments in the doc. :thumbsup:

jax_design: Posting font + mock links shortly.
